verdict.summary: Round 3 remains correct and complete. The added KEEP-list documentation consistently explains why post-merge coverage measurement must remain exempt from the planned push-run skip. The structural test is non-vacuous: its frozen `needs` sets exactly match the live workflow for all three coverage jobs, and its independent scan of job-level `needs.<job>...` references detects the specified `queue-validated` guard when introduced through `if:`. Together with the existing event-envelope assertions, this protects both planned guard shapes without changing production behavior. No correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity issue is evident. The focused unittest could not run in this checkout because PyYAML is unavailable, but the test logic and corresponding live workflow definitions were inspected directly.
